summary: Authored a 4-phase, text-only implementation plan. The boundary rule's hard-coded agent-system/extensions/** target is replaced by a resolution procedure against <project-root>/.claude-extensions.json's extensions.<name>.source_dir (already stamped per extension by the deploy engine, outside .claude/ so it survives a wipe), with an explicit unreachable branch (missing/unparseable file, missing entry, missing source_dir, path absent on disk) that files a task via /task rather than permitting a .claude/** edit. Phase 2 verifies the procedure by hand against ~/Projects/BimodalLogic; Phase 3 aligns the validate-meta-write.sh advisory message and the CLAUDE.md rules-list line; Phase 4 self-checks the boundary. No deploy-machinery change (dispatch option (b) rejected on evidence), no deployed-copy edit, and agents/general-implementation-agent.md is excluded as a concurrent sibling's declared territory.
